sn22.60:1.2: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Vesāliyam viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyam || || 2
sn22.60:1.3: Atha kho Mahāli Licchavi yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || la || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Mahāli Licchavi Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3
sn22.60:2.2: Natthi hetu natthi paccayo sattānaṃ saṃkilesāya ||
sn22.60:2.4: Natthi hetu natthi paccayo sattānam visuddhiyā ||
sn22.60:3.1: Atthi Mahāli hetu atthi paccayo sattānaṃ saṅkilesāya ||
sn22.60:3.3: Atthi Mahāli hetu atthi paccayo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā ||
sn22.60:4.1: Katamo pana bhante hetu katamo paccayo sattānaṃ saṅkilesāya ||
sn22.60:5.1: Rūpañca hidam Mahāli ekantadukkham abhavissa dukkhānupatitaṃ dukkhāvakkantaṃ anavakkantam sukhena || nayidaṃ sattā rūpasmiṃ sārajjeyyuṃ || ||
sn22.60:5.2: Yasmā ca kho Mahāli rūpaṃ sukhaṃ sukhānupatitaṃ sukhāvakkantam anavakkantaṃ dukkhena || tasmā sattā rūpasmiṃ sārajjanti
sn22.60:5.4: Ayam pi kho Mahāli hetu ayam paccayo sattānam saṃkilesāya ||
sn22.60:6.1: Vedanā ca hidam Mahāli ekantadukkhā abhavissa dukkhānupatitā dukkhāvakkantā anavakkantā sukhena || nayidaṃ sattā vedanāya sārajjeyyuṃ || ||
sn22.60:6.2: Yasmā ca kho Mahāli vedanā sukhā sukhānupatitā sukhāvakkantā anavakkantā dukkhena || tasmā sattā vedanāya sārajjanti
sn22.60:6.5: Ayam pi kho Mahāli hetu ayam paccayo sattānaṃ saṃkilesāya ||
sn22.60:7.2: Saṅkhārā ca hidam Mahāli ekantadukkhā abhavissaṃsu dukkhānupatitā dukkhāvakkantā anavakkantā sukhena || na yidaṃ sattā saṅkhāresu sārajjeyyuṃ || ||
sn22.60:7.3: Yasmā ca kho Mahāli saṅkhārā sukhā sukhānupatitā sukhāvakkantā anavakkantā dukkhena || tasmā sattā saṅkhāresu sārajjanti ||
sn22.60:7.6: Ayam pi kho Mahāli hetu ayam paccayo sattānam saṃkilesāya ||
sn22.60:7.7: evam pi kho sahetu-sapaccayā sattā saṃkilissanti || || 10 Viññāṇaṃ
sn22.60:8.1: ca hidam Mahāli ekantadukkham abhavissa dukkhānupatitaṃ dukkhāvakkantam anavakkantam sukhena || nayidaṃ sattā viññāṇasmiṃ sārajjeyyuṃ || ||
sn22.60:8.2: Yasmā ca kho Mahāli viññāṇaṃ sukhaṃ sukhānupatitaṃ sukhāvakkantam anavakkantaṃ dukkhena || tasmā sattā viññāṇasmiṃ sārajjanti
sn22.60:8.4: Ayam pi kho Mahāli hetu ayam paccayo sattānaṃ saṃkilesāya ||
sn22.60:9.1: Katamo pana bhante hetu katamo paccayo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā ||
sn22.60:9.3: Rūpaṃ ca hidam Mahāli ekantasukhaṃ abhavissa sukhānupatitaṃ sukhāvakkantam anavakkantaṃ dukkhena || nayidaṃ sattā rūpasmiṃ nibbindeyyuṃ || ||

sn22.60:9.6: Ayaṃ kho Mahāli hetu ayam paccayo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā ||
